description: This file defines a PHP class for POP3 email protocol authentication used within the PHPMailer library. It includes methods for connecting, logging in, disconnecting, and handling responses from a POP3 server, intended for POP-before-SMTP authentication.

classes.name: PHPMailer\PHPMailer\POP3
classes.description: A lightweight PHP class implementing POP3 protocol features necessary for POP-before-SMTP authentication, including connection management and basic response handling.

methods.name: popBeforeSmtp
methods.description: Static method providing a one-call interface for authenticating with a POP3 server for POP-before-SMTP.

methods.name: authorise
methods.description: Performs connect, login, and disconnect in sequence for POP-before-SMTP authentication.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the specified POP3 server.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with the POP3 server with provided credentials.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the connection to the POP3 server.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Reads a response line from the POP3 server.

methods.name: sendString
methods.description: Sends a string command to the POP3 server.

methods.name: checkResponse
methods.description: Checks if the server response indicates success (+OK).

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns an array of error messages encountered during operations.
